newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Elevadores Atlas started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Elevadores Atlas started.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said on Thursday it started coverage of Brazil's Elevadores Atlas S.A. with a buy rating.

-- In the third quarter of 1996, elevator maker Atlas "generated a quarter-on-quarter revenue increase of 13.8 percent to 97.6 million reais and a quarter-on-quarter net profit increase of 55.7 percent to 10.9 million reais," analyst Ben Uglow wrote in a report.
-- "The revenue result is 8.4 percent ahead of our forecast and the cumulative nine-month net profit of 25.5 million reais is 21.4 percent ahead of our forecast."

-- He added, "It is believed that the earnings data have advanced due to a continuation of the management strategy, particularly with respect to cost reduction, that has been in place for more than two years."
